title: Why didn't Taz stop the Fyre Festival disaster in 2017?
post: The Fyre Festival promised luxury villas... and served a cheese sandwich. So why didn't Taz stop it? Would you pay $12,000 for this? 👇 #taz #looneytunes #fyrefestival #cheesesandwich #didyouknow #fyre
style_suffix: 2D cartoon illustration in the classic Looney Tunes Warner Bros style, bold outlines, vibrant colors, vertical 9:16 composition

wardrobe.Taz: brown furry Tasmanian Devil, beige face and belly, tiny orange FYRE staff lanyard (same in every image after the opening)

beats.say: Why didn't {y:Taz} | stop the {r:Fyre Festival} | disaster | in 2017?

shots.prompt: the Tasmanian Devil Taz from Looney Tunes (brown furry tornado devil, beige face and belly, huge mouth full of teeth, wild eyes) standing with a proud toothy grin, drooling a little, full body, plain pure white background
Realistic aerial drone photo of a tropical beach in the Bahamas covered with rows of white disaster relief tents, turquoise water, chaotic piles of luggage, overcast sky

beats.say: It's no {y:secret} | that Taz was in charge | of the {y:luxury villas} | at the Fyre Festival.

shots.prompt: the Tasmanian Devil Taz from Looney Tunes (brown furry tornado devil, beige face and belly, huge mouth full of teeth, wild eyes, wearing a tiny orange FYRE staff lanyard) standing proudly on a tropical beach in front of a fancy sign that says LUXURY VILLAS, chewing on the corner of the sign

beats.say: He got the job | because nobody | could {r:say no} | to him.

shots.prompt: the Tasmanian Devil Taz from Looney Tunes (brown furry tornado devil, beige face and belly, huge mouth full of teeth, wild eyes) at a job interview sitting on an office chair, chewing a big bite out of the interviewer's desk, the terrified cartoon interviewer handing him a contract with a shaking hand

beats.say: In {y:April 2017}, | guests paid up to | {r:12,000 dollars} per package | for a private island | in the {b:Bahamas}.

shots.prompt: Realistic glossy luxury promo photo of a turquoise private island in the Bahamas with white sand, yachts and models on the beach at sunset, orange tile pattern overlay, influencer advertising style

beats.say: Taz welcomed them | at the airport | with a sign. | He had already eaten | {r:half of it}.

shots.prompt: the Tasmanian Devil Taz from Looney Tunes (brown furry tornado devil, beige face and belly, huge mouth full of teeth, wild eyes, wearing a tiny orange FYRE staff lanyard) welcoming shocked rich festival guests with luggage at a tiny island airport, holding a hand-painted cardboard sign that says WELCOME TO LUXURY with a big bite taken out of it, drool on the sign

beats.say: They found | {r:disaster relief tents} | in the rain.

shots.prompt: Realistic photo of rows of soaked white disaster relief tents on a muddy beach in the rain, some tents torn to shreds, wet mattresses piled outside, festival guests in fancy clothes standing in the mud

beats.say: Taz gave | an {y:official statement}. | It was translated as: | {r:the tents were like that} | when I got here.

shots.prompt: the Tasmanian Devil Taz from Looney Tunes (brown furry tornado devil, beige face and belly, huge mouth full of teeth, wild eyes, wearing a tiny orange FYRE staff lanyard) standing with an innocent angelic face and a fake halo, surrounded by shredded tents, scraps of tent fabric hanging from his teeth
two cartoon festival staff members in orange FYRE t-shirts whispering gossip to each other with suspicious side-eye looks, tropical beach and shredded tents behind them, generic characters

beats.say: Drone footage shows | a {r:tornado} | going through | every single villa.

shots.prompt: Realistic aerial drone photo of a festival beach camp with a small brown cartoon tornado tearing a path through the rows of white tents, fabric flying everywhere. A 2D cartoon Taz the Tasmanian Devil from Looney Tunes (brown furry devil) inserted into the real photo, spinning inside the tornado, only his teeth and eyes visible in the swirl, vertical 9:16

beats.say: And the {y:gourmet food}? | Taz ate | all of it.

shots.prompt: the Tasmanian Devil Taz from Looney Tunes (brown furry tornado devil, beige face and belly, huge mouth full of teeth, wild eyes, wearing a tiny orange FYRE staff lanyard) spinning like a tornado through a fancy catering buffet, lobsters, sushi and champagne bottles flying into his huge open mouth, chefs running away

beats.say: Only one thing | was left: | a {y:cheese sandwich}. | Even Taz | {r:spat it out}.

shots.prompt: Realistic close-up photo of an open white styrofoam takeout box containing two slices of plain white bread with two slices of American cheese and a small side salad, on a table, harsh daylight

the Tasmanian Devil Taz from Looney Tunes (brown furry tornado devil, beige face and belly, huge mouth full of teeth, wild eyes, wearing a tiny orange FYRE staff lanyard) spitting out a bite of a plain cheese sandwich with a disgusted face, tongue out, eyes crossed, holding the styrofoam box

beats.say: And this part is {y:real}: | a photo of that sandwich | went {r:viral} | around the world.
The festival | was {r:canceled}. | Guests were stuck | on the island. | The organizer, {y:Billy McFarland}, | got {r:6 years} in prison.

shots.prompt: Realistic photo of an abandoned festival site on a tropical beach at dusk, shredded tents, a fallen FYRE banner with big bite marks lying in the sand, empty and quiet

Realistic close-up photo of a wooden judge's gavel on a courtroom bench, dramatic light, the gavel handle has a small bite taken out of it. A 2D cartoon Taz the Tasmanian Devil from Looney Tunes (brown furry devil) inserted into the real photo, tiny and hidden as a reflection on the shiny brass part of the gavel, vertical 9:16

beats.say: Taz got | his bonus: | the {y:cheese sandwich}. | The one he spat out.

shots.prompt: the Tasmanian Devil Taz from Looney Tunes (brown furry tornado devil, beige face and belly, huge mouth full of teeth, wild eyes, wearing a tiny orange FYRE staff lanyard) receiving the half-eaten cheese sandwich in a styrofoam box on a silver tray as an EMPLOYEE BONUS from a cartoon manager in a suit, Taz looking at it with disgust, a small banner that says THANK YOU TAZ

beats.say: And when reporters ask | why Taz | didn't stop | the Fyre Festival, | he just says: | {r:Blrrblrrbl}.

shots.prompt: the Tasmanian Devil Taz from Looney Tunes (brown furry tornado devil, beige face and belly, huge mouth full of teeth, wild eyes, wearing a tiny orange FYRE staff lanyard) surrounded by a crowd of cartoon reporters pushing microphones and cameras at his face on a beach, camera flashes

the Tasmanian Devil Taz from Looney Tunes (brown furry tornado devil, beige face and belly, huge mouth full of teeth, wild eyes, wearing a tiny orange FYRE staff lanyard) spinning into a wild brown tornado and blasting away through the crowd of reporters, microphones and notepads flying, a big speech bubble that says BLRRBLRRBL!

beats.say: Which translates to: | why didn't {y:you} | {r:stop it}?
